Ülke içinde yerinden edilmiş kişiler (IDP): highest regions — West (405000), South (195000), Centre (170000); difference between regions Kruskal-Wallis H=27.34, p=0.001, Holm-adjusted p=0.004 → SIGNIFICANT (α=0.05).

- Geri dönenler (kişi): dönem içinde veri yok

DATA NOTES:
- Koruma: insani yardıma ihtiyaç duyan kişiler: HDX HAPI holds two totals for 2025: 349,999 without a breakdown and 466,589 as the total of its breakdown (used); the HNO's published sector figure may differ
- Koruma: insani yardıma ihtiyaç duyan kişiler, 2024: the plan reports protection in separate lines (Child Protection 1,253,982, Gender Based Violence 1,171,183); this figure (250,000) is below one of the plan's protection lines, so it is not the plan's overall protection figure; HDX HAPI does not say which of the plan's lines it is; this report does not add the lines up, because people can be counted in more than one.
- Koruma: insani yardıma ihtiyaç duyan kişiler, 2025: the plan reports protection in separate lines (Child Protection 1,611,291, Gender Based Violence 1,535,819); this figure (466,589) is below one of the plan's protection lines, so it is not the plan's overall protection figure; HDX HAPI does not say which of the plan's lines it is; this report does not add the lines up, because people can be counted in more than one.
- Ülke içinde yerinden edilmiş kişiler (IDP) (trend look-back 2020-12-31 to 2025-12-31): only the DTM operation 'Countrywide monitoring' is used; 1 other operation(s) count displacement differently and are not mixed in; 6 incomplete round(s) covering under 80% of its regions are left out

METHOD NOTES:
- Trend: Mann-Kendall test; the slope is Sen's slope per year on the real dates of the periods; Kendall tau is the effect size.
- Regions: Kruskal-Wallis test across admin-1 regions.
- Correlation: Pearson, only for indicator pairs with at least 8 common periods.
- Multiple comparisons: Holm correction across all 3 tests in this report; significance is decided on the Holm-adjusted p-value at α=0.05.
- Limitation: the series are short; the tests assume independent observations and serial correlation between consecutive periods is not corrected for, so the results are indicative.
